timing_scope: public runner including input/model construction and validation; excludes imports, export and plots
method_order: serial, rotated P_DM/GH/AGH by measured repeat; warmups excluded from summaries
summary_policy: all measured attempts in timings; only accepted runs in quality; median and inclusive quartiles
gap_policy: signed 100*(J-J*)/abs(J*) against accepted OPTIMAL P_DM with matching input SHA, unit/paper policy, repeat and seed; absent if undefined
incumbent_comparison_policy: separate signed percent difference against accepted same-run P_DM incumbent; does not claim optimality
objective_units: USD; coherent units, primary Paper v2, explicit data residency
service_metric: unweighted per-query mean unmet fraction; u>0.01 classification, distinct from constraint feasibility
no_incumbent_evidence: public P_DM runner raises without a record; exact exception retained, structured solver timing/bound/status unavailable; messages are not parsed

provenance.description: Synthetic multidimensional expansion of heterogeneous tiny inputs; not Azure-calibrated or recovered paper coefficients.
provenance.query_cloning_rule: alternating q_short, q_long in input order
provenance.coordinate_rule: 0,1; dyadic odd numerators by increasing denominator
provenance.coefficient_interpolation_rule: bilinear: model first, then GPU tier
provenance.new_tier_parallelism_rule: union of source sets: TP=(1,2), PP=(1,2)
provenance.capacity_scaling_rule: source budget and storage capacity * I/2

source_snapshot_scope: copied before scientific imports and loaded directly from the snapshot

publication.source_snapshot_recovery: Extract source_snapshot.zip in this directory to restore source_snapshot/ and the recorded input_config_snapshot.
publication.evidence_compression: gzip; decompression recovers the exact measured evidence.jsonl bytes
publication.csv_transport: LF line endings; original numeric and categorical fields preserved

plotting.generation: Rendered after measurement from the recorded CSV; runtime uses a logarithmic axis and objective/component views use independent linear scales by family. The original measured renderer remains in source_snapshot.zip.
plotting.svg_transport: LF line endings and trailing XML whitespace removed; parsed drawing nodes and values are preserved
